A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ADePT study. Their text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original ADePT benchmark results, timing measurements, few-shot experiments and component ablations in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports unsuccessful GSM8K instruction-tuning attempts in Appendix B.3.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same short soft prompt and token-shared, two-layer ReLU network for embedding offsets, with unchanged objectives in Equations 3–4. The new conditional discussion of precomputing offsets does not establish a change to the evaluated procedure.

E1.justification: Appendix B.3 adds attempted GSM8K mathematical-reasoning instruction tuning with Llama3-8B, reported only qualitatively. Existing NLP, code-generation and few-shot coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding benchmark, timing, ablation and few-shot comparisons. The new GSM8K attempt includes the existing DePT comparator without introducing a new comparison method.

E3.justification: The added GSM8K attempt specifies Llama3-8B instruction tuning with 7,473 training and 1,319 test examples. Previously reported splits, metrics, training budgets and hyperparameters remain unchanged; the new attempt lacks detailed evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The cyclic-shift tests, offset statistics, component ablations, prompt-length and bottleneck sweeps, and few-shot analyses are retained. Few-shot results move to Appendix B.2. GSM8K adds a failed benchmark attempt without a separate diagnostic analysis or controlled ablation.

E5.justification: Table 4 and the relocated few-shot table retain their three-run reporting and uncertainty values. No new seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty estimates accompany the GSM8K report.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results are unchanged, including ADePT's GLUE mean of 86.6 in Table 3 and MBPP scores of 17.86 and 43.22 in Table 7. Appendix B.3 adds the qualitative finding that both ADePT and DePT training attempts on GSM8K were unsuccessful.

T1.justification: Section 3.4 and Appendix A retain the same attention derivations and conclusions, including Equations 5–8. Prompt-length symbols are clarified, but no mathematical assumptions, proofs or substantive derivations are added.

C1.justification: v2 explicitly foregrounds theoretical analysis as a contribution in the abstract, introduction and conclusion, including greater expressive power than PT and DePT. The analysis already existed in v1; the central method and empirical superiority claims remain.

C2.justification: Section 4.5 adds an untested argument that precomputing offsets could eliminate overhead and potentially exceed DePT's inference speed. Appendix B.3 adds a limitation and tentative capacity-based explanation for failed GSM8K tuning. The existing few-shot limitation is retained after relocation.

D1.justification: Table 16's revised caption omits the explicit STS-B regression range [0,5] and the statement that few-shot examples come only from the original training set. Code links and implementation settings remain; few-shot initialization details move from Section 4.1 to Appendix C.

R1.justification: v2 adds Cobbe et al. (2021) to support the GSM8K discussion. Existing references and substantive positioning against other prompt-tuning and PEFT methods remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes local prose and notation edits, expands the conclusion, adds acknowledgments, and updates publication and affiliation text. Few-shot material moves to the appendices, and Appendix B gains subsections; the overall narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: The same overview figure and 19 tables remain. The few-shot table moves from main-text Table 8 to Appendix Table 15, other tables are repositioned or renumbered, the longer-prompt table is widened, and Table 16's caption and headers are revised.

improvement.justification: The added GSM8K failure report modestly improves transparency about applicability, and the editorial changes clarify organization. Gains are limited: the failure lacks quantitative diagnostics, the proposed precomputation speed advantage remains untested, and Table 16 loses two data-description details. The numerical evidence and theoretical analysis are otherwise unchanged.
